Weird.Baby · Ops · the material in hand · surveyed 2026-09-17

The Material

Every clip and take Ops can find, one row a file: what it is, when, how long, which lane it serves, whether it is usable and why, which template takes it, and a decision for you. 174 rows in 9 places. The pieces cut today are in the Finished reels folder under material.

How to rule. Each row's decision is A, B or C; Ops' recommendation is the green one. Say the row number and the letter, or a group and one letter for all of it. A row whose decision reads "same ruling as…" follows its parent. Nothing on this page has been moved, renamed or deleted.

The porch session of 08-242 rows · OneDrive › Desktop - Computer Room

Found by the survey; on no ledger, in no folder of the system. The Audigo's own export: a movie and its sound.

#WhatWhen · lengthLane · usable · templateWhyDecision
1 AudigoTrack1.movThe front-porch session: Mike in the wicker chair, guitar, the Audigo on a stand; one static portrait frame for 22 minutes. Three full takes of Coconuts, one false start, an abandoned E.D. Yahdah, and his talk between takes ("we're here for reels"). Never logged anywhere until today.
The take map, from the transcript: talk and setup 0:15 to 7:40; false starts 7:43 to 9:30; TAKE 1 10:05 to 12:07 (clean, his own verdict 'that was coconuts'); TAKE 2 12:44 to 16:20 (breaks at 14:26, restarts from the bridge); TAKE 3 18:05 to 20:05 ('a couple of screw ups'); E.D. Yahdah attempt 20:20 to 22:24 ('I gotta practice that more').
 2026-08-24
22:25
1080x1920

number		 Real performance with a real microphone (24-bit), portrait, already the Number's shape. The frame is wide and he is small in it; the room noise is the landscapers and the cicadas, which he names on tape. The takes are complete enough to cut pieces from today (see the pieces below). A the session is Number material: Ops cuts pieces from take 1 and take 3 by the ruled piece list (hook, verse, bridge, the story, hook again)B keep for the live-single rehearsal reference only; shoot the Number fresh with the DJI pairC discard: the frame is too wide
